query:
select coalesce(md5(string_agg(w.title || chr(31) || wl.locator || chr(31)
                                          || array_to_string(wl.aliases, chr(30)), chr(29)
                                          order by w.title, wl.locator)), '') as "v!"
           from work_locator wl join work w on w.id = wl.work_id
